contexts.text: In some Hells appear as it were the ruins of houses and cities after conflagrations, in which the infernal Spirits dwell... SE 4897. SE 5598.
They do not appear like a house, but like a heap such as is [formed] of ruins.
As the ruins of temples [built] of such rocks are wont to appear. SE 3936.
Around the cities... and elsewhere, appear... also great ruins of houses...
At last I arrived at the ruins of houses...
